answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a slowly accreted stake record, much as glacier deposits layers that cannot be forged overnight, so new sybils start with near-zero weight. A delta between claimed and observed stake history is checked against a shared shale-like ledger of hardened checkpoints, forcing colluders to fund every fake identity at full cost. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
